figures.caption: Multiple sequence alignments of Ll-CATH amino acid sequences with other amphibians. The shading threshold is set at 60%. Gray shading represents similar residues, black indicates identical residues, and hyphens (-) represent alignment gaps. The signal peptide, cathelin domain, and mature peptide are indicated above the alignment. The predicted cleavage site for the signal peptide or mature peptide is marked with a downward arrow (↓). The four conserved cysteine residues are denoted by an asterisk (*)
figures.label: Fig. 1

figures.caption: Phylogenetic analysis of cathelicidin amino acid sequences using the neighbor-joining method. Fork values represent the percentage of trees supporting each grouping after bootstrapping (1000 replicates; shown only when > 60%). Scale bar indicates the number of substitutions per base
figures.label: Fig. 2
